County Ballot Question 1A
Shall the Assessor, Clerk and Recorder, Surveyor, and Treasurer for Montezuma County be allowed, if elected by the registered electors of Montezuma County, to serve an unlimited number of consecutive terms?

Ballot Title and Text — BALLOT ISSUE NO. 2A:
SHALL CITY OF CORTEZ TAXES BE INCREASED NOT MORE THAN
$900,000.00 IN TAX COLLECTION YEAR 2027 AND BY WHATEVER
AMOUNTS AS ARE GENERATED ANNUALLY THEREAFTER BY
INCREASING THE CITY LODGERS’ TAX FROM 2% TO 6% EFFECTIVE
JANUARY 1, 2027, AND SHALL THE LODGERS’ TAX REVENUES RECEIVED
BY THE CITY BE USED FOR THE FOLLOWING PURPOSES:
• INVESTING IN TOURISM MARKETING, INCLUDING ADVERTISING THE
COMMUNITY;
• ATTRACTING AND FACILITATING ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND
REDEVELOPMENT OF PROPERTIES AND INFRASTRUCTURE WITHIN
THE CITY, INCLUDING IMPROVING WALKABILITY, LANDSCAPING,
STRUCTURES, AND OTHER IMPROVEMENTS; AND
• INVESTING IN ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS, PROGRAMS AND
FACILITIES;
PROVIDED THAT THE COUNCIL SHALL ADOPT AN ORDINANCE TO
IMPLEMENT THE TAX INCREASE AS PROVIDED IN THIS QUESTION
(INCLUDING PROVISIONS FOR THE METHOD OF COLLECTION AND
ENFORCEMENT, ANY EXEMPTIONS FROM THE TAX, AND OTHER
DETAILS) AND MAY ADJUST THE RATE OF THE LODGERS’ TAX FROM
TIME TO TIME SO LONG AS IT DOES NOT EXCEED 6%; AND SHALL ALL
AMOUNTS RECEIVED BY THE CITY FROM SUCH TAX AND THE
EARNINGS THEREON BE COLLECTED AND SPENT WITHOUT LIMITATION
OR CONDITION AS A VOTER-APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE UNDER
ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE COLORADO CONSTITUTION, OR ANY
OTHER LAW?

Ballot Title and Text — Town of Mancos Ballot Issue 2B:
SHALL TOWN OF MANCOS TAXES BE INCREASED $325,000 IN 2027 (FIRST
FULL FISCAL YEAR) BY SUCH AMOUNTS AS MAY BE GENERATED
THROUGH THE IMPOSITION OF AN ADDITIONAL TOWN-WIDE SALES
TAX OF .40% (FOR A TOTAL SALES TAX OF 4.4%) TO BE UTILIZED
EXCLUSIVELY FOR STREET IMPROVEMENTS, BROADBAND CAPITAL
IMPROVEMENTS, EQUIPMENT AND OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE
RELATING TO THE SAME; SUCH TAX INCREASES TO COMMENCE
JANUARY 1, 2027 AND CONTINUE ANNUALLY THEREAFTER; AND SHALL
SUCH TAX REVENUES AND INVESTMENT EARNINGS THEREON BE
COLLECTED, RETAINED AND SPENT AS A VOTER APPROVED REVENUE
CHANGE AND AN EXCEPTION TO THE LIMITS WHICH WOULD
OTHERWISE APPLY UNDER ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE COLORADO
CONSTITUTION OR ANY OTHER LAW?

BALLOT TITLE AND TEXT — BALLOT ISSUE NO. 1B:
SHALL MONTEZUMA COUNTY LODGING TAXES BE INCREASED BY
$404,598 IN TAX COLLECTION YEAR 2027 AND BY WHATEVER AMOUNTS
ARE GENERATED ANNUALLY THEREAFTER BY INCREASING THE
COUNTY LODGING TAX FROM 2% TO 5% EFFECTIVE JANUARY 1, 2027,
EXCLUDING THE MUNICIPALITY OF CORTEZ WHICH HAS ITS OWN
LODGING TAX, AND SHALL THE LODGING TAX REVENUES RECEIVED
BY THE COUNTY BE USED FOR THE FOLLOWING PURPOSES:
• TOURISM PROMOTION AND MARKETING;
• RECREATION, OUTDOOR RECREATION, AND VISITOR-RELATED
INFRASTRUCTURE IMPROVEMENTS;
• DESTINATION DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS AND VISITOR EXPERIENCE
ENHANCEMENTS;
• TOURISM RESILIENCY, EMERGENCY RESPONSE, AND RECOVERY
EFFORTS RELATED TO EVENTS AFFECTING VISITATION;
• ADMINISTRATION, OVERSIGHT, AND IMPLEMENTATION OF
AUTHORIZED LODGING TAX PROGRAMS;
AND SHALL THE COUNTY BE AUTHORIZED TO COLLECT, RETAIN, AND
SPEND ALL REVENUES GENERATED BY SUCH TAX AS A VOTER-
APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE UNDER ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE
COLORADO CONSTITUTION, OR ANY OTHER LAW?
